infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Retrofit uses the camera to scan your room, so you can get a tenant quote without filling in a form.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Retrofit reads device motion to tell how far you have turned, so it knows which parts of the room you have already scanned.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Retrofit reads your compass heading while you scan, to map each photo to a direction in the room. Your location is never stored or shared.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Retrofit can use three photos from your library instead of a camera sweep, so a quote is still possible if scanning does not work for you.
